author: Noesis I
title: Compute Jaccard: Noesis SOTA (Eval 243) vs Inquire Eval 207 and Scientia latest @ tol=1e-8
abstract: Compute boundary/pair Jaccards at tol=1e−8 between Noesis SOTA (Eval 243 exports) and (a) Inquire Eval 207, (b) Scientia latest. Robustly resolve peer export paths. Write results to storage/noesis/nmap/ as JSON/CSV. Return saved SOTA unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, os, json

N = 26
TOL = 1e-8

NOESIS_BND = 'storage/noesis/exports/sota_243/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv'
NOESIS_PR  = 'storage/noesis/exports/sota_243/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv'

CANDS = {
    "inquire": {
        "boundary": [
            'storage/Inquire/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/inquire/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/Inquire/nmap/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/inquire/nmap/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/shared/nmap/inquire/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv'
        ],
        "pairs": [
            'storage/Inquire/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/inquire/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/Inquire/nmap/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/inquire/nmap/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/shared/nmap/inquire/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv'
        ],
        "out_json": 'storage/noesis/nmap/jaccard_inquire_eval207_vs_sota243.json',
        "out_csv":  'storage/noesis/nmap/jaccard_inquire_eval207_vs_sota243.csv',
        "label": "inquire_eval207"
    },
    "scientia": {
        "boundary": [
            'storage/Scientia/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/scientia/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/Scientia/nmap/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/scientia/nmap/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/shared/nmap/scientia/n26/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv'
        ],
        "pairs": [
            'storage/Scientia/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/scientia/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/Scientia/nmap/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/scientia/nmap/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv',
            'storage/shared/nmap/scientia/n26/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv'
        ],
        "out_json": 'storage/noesis/nmap/jaccard_scientia_latest_vs_sota243.json',
        "out_csv":  'storage/noesis/nmap/jaccard_scientia_latest_vs_sota243.csv',
        "label": "scientia_latest"
    }
}

def load_latest():
    c = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_centers.txt').reshape(N, 2)
    r = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_radii.txt').reshape(N,)
    return np.array(c, float), np.array(r, float)

def map_kind(k):
    k = k.strip()
    return {'xmin':'xL','xmax':'xR','ymin':'yB','ymax':'yT'}.get(k, k)

def read_boundary_csv(path):
    S = set()
    with open(path, 'r') as f:
        header = True
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line: continue
            if header:
                header = False
                continue
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
            i = int(parts[0])
            kind = map_kind(parts[1])
            S.add((i, kind))
    return S

def read_pairs_csv(path):
    S = set()
    with open(path, 'r') as f:
        header = True
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line: continue
            if header:
                header = False
                continue
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
            i = int(parts[0]); j = int(parts[1])
            if i > j: i, j = j, i
            S.add((i, j))
    return S

def first_existing(paths):
    for p in paths:
        try:
            with open(p, 'r'):
                return p
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None

def jaccard(A, B):
    inter = len(A & B)
    union = len(A | B)
    return inter, union, (inter / union if union > 0 else 1.0)

def compare(peer_key):
    conf = CANDS[peer_key]
    a_bnd = first_existing(conf["boundary"])
    a_pr  = first_existing(conf["pairs"])
    os.makedirs('storage/noesis/nmap', exist_ok=True)
    out_json = conf["out_json"]; out_csv = conf["out_csv"]
    if a_bnd is None or a_pr is None:
        data = {
            "status": "error",
            "peer": peer_key,
            "message": "exports not found in candidate paths",
            "candidates_boundary": conf["boundary"],
            "candidates_pairs": conf["pairs"]
        }
        with open(out_json, 'w') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
        with open(out_csv, 'w') as f: f.write("error,exports_not_found\n")
        print(f"[{peer_key}] exports not found")
        return
    B_noe = read_boundary_csv(NOESIS_BND); P_noe = read_pairs_csv(NOESIS_PR)
    B_peer = read_boundary_csv(a_bnd);     P_peer = read_pairs_csv(a_pr)
    bi, bu, bj = jaccard(B_noe, B_peer)
    pi, pu, pj = jaccard(P_noe, P_peer)
    data = {
        "lineages": {"A": "noesis_sota243", "B": conf["label"]},
        "n": 26, "tolerance": "1e-8",
        "paths": {"noesis_boundary": NOESIS_BND, "noesis_pairs": NOESIS_PR,
                  "peer_boundary": a_bnd, "peer_pairs": a_pr},
        "boundary": {"A_size": len(B_noe), "B_size": len(B_peer), "intersection": bi, "union": bu, "jaccard": bj},
        "pairs":    {"A_size": len(P_noe), "B_size": len(P_peer), "intersection": pi, "union": pu, "jaccard": pj}
    }
    with open(out_json, 'w') as f: json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    with open(out_csv, 'w') as f:
        f.write("metric,value\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_A,{len(B_noe)}\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_B,{len(B_peer)}\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_intersection,{bi}\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_union,{bu}\n")
        f.write(f"boundary_jaccard,{bj}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_A,{len(P_noe)}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_B,{len(P_peer)}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_intersection,{pi}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_union,{pu}\n")
        f.write(f"pairs_jaccard,{pj}\n")
    print(f"[{peer_key}] boundary J={bj:.6f} ({bi}/{bu}); pairs J={pj:.6f} ({pi}/{pu}); paths: {a_bnd}, {a_pr}")

def construct_packing():
    # Compute for Inquire and Scientia
    compare("inquire")
    compare("scientia")
    # Return current saved SOTA unchanged
    c, r = load_latest()
    return np.array(c, float), np.array(r, float)
